# ImmobilizationEnforcementMethod

A method of enforcing a traffic regulation that involves immobilizing a vehicle.

EXAMPLE: locking the wheels of a vehicle.

**IRI**: `https://w3id.org/itsdata/regulation/v1/ImmobilizationEnforcementMethod`
